description: This file contains unit tests for the ShelfController class in a Java Spring Boot backend project, testing various endpoints related to shelf management such as retrieving all shelves, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves, with mock services for dependencies.

classes.name: ShelfControllerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ShelfController, covering scenarios like retrieving shelves, creating, renaming, and deleting shelves with various validation checks.

methods.name: all_returnsEmptyList_whenNoShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' endpoint returns an empty list when no shelves exist for the logged in user.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenPredefinedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' endpoint returns predefined shelves when they exist for the user.

methods.name: all_returnsNonEmptyList_whenUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' endpoint returns user-created shelves when they exist.

methods.name: all_returnsNonCombinedList_whenBothPredefinedAndUserCreatedShelvesExist
methods.description: Tests that the 'all' endpoint returns a combined list of predefined and user-created shelves.

methods.name: create_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameTaken
methods.description: Tests that creating a shelf with a name that already exists results in a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: create_throws_ifNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecified
methods.description: Tests that creating a shelf with null or empty name results in a Bad Request.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForLocatingShelf
methods.description: Tests that renaming a shelf with null or empty old shelf name throws a Bad Request.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfNoNameOrEmptyNameSpecifiedForNewName
methods.description: Tests that renaming a shelf with null or empty new name throws a Bad Request.

methods.name: renameShelf_ThrowsIfUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that renaming a non-existent shelf results in a Not Found error.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifShelfNameIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that deleting a shelf with null or empty name results in a Bad Request.

methods.name: deleteShelf_returnsBadRequest_ifUserCreatedShelfDoesNotExist
methods.description: Tests that deleting a non-existent shelf results in a Not Found response.
